title.narrative: High Value Opportunity - Brazil, Improving Effluent Treatment Efficiency, SABESP ¿ SANASA, São Paulo

description.narrative:
The objectives of the development cooperation among the parties is to contribute to the economic development of the project country with sustainability and responsibility as key elements of the project, according to the HVO-objectives in the Government Strategy on Export promotion and economic diplomacy (3.3).
NovozymesBiological products have a significant impact on improving the sewage treatment process, thus improving the quality of the effluents which are discharged into rivers and into nature, thereby reducing the environmental impact of the effluents from industrial and domestic sewage
The MFA Department, São Paulo will base the actual support on progress attained in the implementation of the engagement. Progress will be measured through dialogue and the results frame for the project.
